setting.accent_color.help: Controls the system accent color for buttons, highlights and shortcuts. Colorful adds multi-hue shortcuts and pairs with a rainbow title by default. Previews live as you browse options.
setting.after_resolve.help: Downloading and saving the command both request a license and keep the command file and keys. Listing tracks requests no keys. Export saves the manifest, tracks, and keys for offline import.
setting.after_resolve.option.command: Don't download, just save the command
setting.after_resolve.option.export: Save an export file: the manifest, the tracks and the keys
setting.after_resolve.option.list: Just list the tracks, ask for no keys
setting.audio_format.help: Applies to audio-only titles - radio, podcasts - and is ignored for anything with a picture.
setting.audio_format.option.source: Keep the original, do not re-encode
setting.audio_langs.help: Comma separated BCP-47/ISO tags or original, e.g. original,en. Original requires an explicit track marker. Empty = best available language.
setting.audio_profile.help: A profile is an audio feature or role, not the codec. Atmos is normally E-AC-3 plus a JOC/Atmos marker.
setting.audio_quality.help: Quality is ranked only after language, codec, profile and channel filters have matched.
setting.audio_selection.help: Best one per language keeps commentary and duplicate renditions out unless All is chosen.
setting.auto_subtitle_fix.help: De-duplicate and tidy text cues while converting subtitles.
setting.beta_auto_results.help: Choose result types shown in Auto. All are enabled by default. Unchecked types are not searched or displayed automatically, but their explicit modes remain available. An empty selection hides all Auto results. Remote vault search remains explicit.
setting.beta_interface.help: Use the experimental search-first home. Off keeps the classic home. Applies on returning home without interrupting active sessions.
setting.cdm_any.help: Which CDM this service uses. Empty follows the app-wide choice; a selected device affects this service only.
setting.cdm_playready.help: Which CDM this service uses. Empty follows the app-wide choice; a selected device affects this service only.
setting.cdm_rule_condition.help: Matches the selected track's resolution label (same label used in filenames, e.g. a 1080p rule covers tracks labeled 1080p).
setting.cdm_rules.help: Choose which CDM device to use based on video resolution. Leave empty to use one device for all resolutions.
setting.cdm_widevine.help: Which CDM this service uses. Empty follows the app-wide choice; a selected device affects this service only.
setting.check_segments_count.help: Fail a track when the number of downloaded parts does not match the manifest.
setting.completion_alert.help: Notify through your terminal when a download batch finishes or stops with errors. Auto uses OSC notifications in supported terminals and falls back to the terminal bell.
setting.confirm_batch.help: Ask once before processing a multi-episode selection.
setting.debug.help: Verbose logging, keeps temp files, writes stream metadata and a session log. It also enables the explicit Ctrl+R service-code reload on the main screen.
setting.default_audio.help: Choose the default muxed audio from selected tracks only: Auto, Original, or one language tag. This does not download extra tracks.
setting.default_subtitle.help: Choose the default muxed subtitle from selected tracks only: Auto, Original, or one language tag. This does not download extra tracks.
setting.delete_temp_after_done.help: Remove temporary segment directories when a title finishes successfully.
setting.dolby_vision_hybrid.help: Combine matching selected Dolby Vision and HDR10/HDR10+ video tracks with dovi_tool. Empty follows the global setting.
setting.download_attachments.help: Save available attachments after a successful media download. Off keeps metadata, previews and exports without saving attachment files. Fetch title attachments is separate.
setting.download_dir.help: Choose a download folder here without editing YAML. Leave empty to use paths.downloads if configured, otherwise the default output folder.
setting.download_manager.help: Choose what happens after a title is resolved, native transfer options that are not per-service track settings, whether live streams are recorded, whether DRM waits for the final selected tracks, and whether batch downloads ask for confirmation.
setting.drm_system.help: Which CDM to use when a service offers a choice. Each system needs its own library and its own device file; one that is not installed says so.
setting.drop_video.help: Regular expression for excluding preview or thumbnail video tracks without accidentally matching normal titles.
setting.embed_chapters: Embed chapters in the final file
setting.embed_chapters.help: When the service provides chapter metadata, write it into the final MKV/MP4 container. Turning this off keeps chapters in the report, saved command metadata and export, but does not mux them into media.
setting.embed_lyrics: Embed lyrics in the final audio file
setting.embed_lyrics.help: Write a plain-text lyrics tag into compatible audio files. Turning this off retains timed lyrics for display and export.
setting.episode_folder_template.help: Optional folders below the service directory for episodes. Empty keeps the flat layout. Use {series}, {season}, {season_number}, {year}, {season_episode} and {service}.
setting.fetch_actual_bitrate.help: After final video selection, sample media response sizes to show an actual bitrate and correct available color metadata. Off skips the probe. Follows the global default until this service saves an override.
setting.fetch_attachments.help: Allow this service to request optional poster, thumbnail and artwork metadata for preview and export. Download title attachments separately controls saving files.
setting.fetch_chapters.help: Allow this service to request optional chapter metadata. Off skips optional chapter endpoints and fields; failures never stop playback or downloads. Until saved for this service, the previous global preference is inherited. Embedding chapters in the final file is a separate output setting.
setting.http_timeout.help: Timeout for each native downloader HTTP request.
setting.interface_locale.help: Language of UniDL's own labels, prompts and settings. Service names, titles, URLs and API locales are not translated. Follow the system reads LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG.
setting.interface_manager.help: Choose the color theme, interface language and diagnostic logging. Debug mode also enables the explicit service-code reload shortcut; it never watches files.
setting.justwatch_manager.help: Configure JustWatch search and availability regions, upcoming release sources, TMDB API key, and background scheduling.
setting.justwatch_regions.help: Regions checked for streaming availability, in order (comma-separated ISO country codes).
setting.justwatch_search_region.help: Region catalog used for title search (single ISO country code).
setting.keep_failed_intermediates.help: Keep the failed work directory, including incomplete outputs, for debugging. Valid resume checkpoints are separate and follow Reuse downloaded segments.
setting.keep_temp.help: Keep segment and track-stage caches after a successful download. Debug mode also keeps them. This is not required for failure recovery.
setting.layout_density.help: Controls vertical spacing, banner height, and compact padding across screens. Auto switches to compact layout in short terminal windows.
setting.license_action.help: Before uses the default Widevine PSSH or full PlayReady inventory. After licenses final selected encrypted tracks only. Custom delegates the plan to the service.
setting.license_after_tracks.help: Compatibility mode for services whose license init data is only available on selected media playlists. Off keeps full-manifest inventory licensing.
setting.live_keep_segments.help: Keep per-segment live files in tmp after recording.
setting.live_pipe_mux.help: Mux live audio/video after recording. Ignored for audio-only titles.
setting.live_real_time_merge.help: Append live segments to the output as they arrive instead of waiting until stop.
setting.live_record.help: Off, a live channel is resolved and its command saved without recording. On, UniDL records for as long as the service's live recording length says.
setting.live_record_limit.help: How long a recording runs before UniDL stops it: HH:MM:SS, seconds, or 1h20m. 00:00:00 means no length limit.
setting.live_replay.help: Offer the live channel's replay/DVR window after the final tracks are selected.
setting.local_vault.help: On, a title whose key IDs are all already in the local vault is served from there and no license request is made. Off, every title goes through a real license exchange. Keys are still written to selected local write targets either way.
setting.max_speed.help: Cap segment download speed, e.g. 15M, 100K, 2Mbps. Empty means unlimited.
setting.muxer.help: Which tool writes the final container. Auto prefers mkvmerge for MKV. No mux saves joined, decrypted original tracks separately, without audio/subtitle conversion or Hybrid processing. Container is ignored in No mux mode. MP4Box writes MP4 for ordinary video/audio too. 3D VOD automatically uses MP4Box and MP4; install GPAC/MP4Box and add it to PATH.
setting.name_template_episode.help: Episode filename prefix. Resolution, platform, and release tag are appended by the release suffix template.
setting.name_template_movie.help: Filename prefix for movies and single videos (uses title, year, and episode_name).
setting.output_scope.help: Choose which media types automatic selection should output. Normal package keeps the existing video, audio and subtitle behavior.
setting.output_scope.option.subtitle: Subtitle only
setting.output_types.help: Used when Output scope is Custom. Comma separated: video, audio, subtitle.
setting.poster_preview.help: Show 2:3 movie and series posters beside scheduled downloads, upcoming radar, and JustWatch results. Auto enables posters only on terminals with native image protocols (Kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm) and hides them on macOS Terminal.app or narrow windows.
setting.proxy.help: Empty means direct. A value is either a name from the proxies section of unidl.yaml or a full URI.
setting.proxy_downloads.help: Only read when a proxy is set. On, segment downloads use it too. Off, UniDL fetches segments directly.
setting.proxy_manager.help: Set the global proxy route, toggle segment proxying, and manage named proxies and VPN providers.
setting.release_tag.help: What goes after the dash at the end of a file name. Left off entirely when empty.
setting.release_template: What is added after the name
setting.release_template.help: What is added after the title. Audio and video fields come from the tracks finally selected for download.
setting.remote_vault.help: Allow reading from and writing to remote vaults configured under key_vaults. Off by default to avoid unexpected network requests.
setting.remote_vault_auto_lookup.help: Query selected remote vaults for this service's KIDs before licensing.
setting.remote_vault_auto_store: Store licensed keys in remote vaults
setting.remote_vault_auto_store.help: Store this service's acquired keys in selected remote writable vaults.
setting.resource_manager.help: Manage DRM/CDM defaults, local and remote CDM devices, and key vaults.
setting.resume_parts.help: On, reuse verified segments and completed download/decrypt/processing checkpoints after failure or cancellation. Off starts every track from scratch.
setting.retries.help: How many times a failed segment is retried before the track fails.
setting.segment_downloader.help: The native engine's segment backend. aria2c is used only when chosen and installed.
setting.semantic_colors.help: Controls success, warning, and error colors across screens and logs. Colorblind-friendly replaces red/green cues with high-contrast teal, amber, and magenta.
setting.services_manager.help: Manage licensing defaults, service registration, homepage visibility, chapters, attachments, actual video bitrate and export manifest type. New registrations require a UniDL restart.
setting.storage_manager.help: Manage output folders and filename templates. Runtime paths are shown read-only for reference.
setting.sub_format.help: ASS with MKV preserves common subtitle positions. SRT keeps top-alignment tags where supported; WebVTT retains cue settings and styles. MP4 may lose positioning.
setting.sub_langs.help: Comma separated BCP-47/ISO tags or original, e.g. original,en; 'all', or empty to skip. Original requires an explicit track marker.
setting.subtitle_kinds.help: Comma separated: normal, forced, sdh, commentary, audio_description, or all.
setting.subtitle_output.help: Choose whether selected subtitles are embedded in the final container, kept as external sidecar files beside it, or skipped.
setting.subtitle_selection.help: Normal and forced may both be selected. Choose Best one when only one subtitle per language is wanted.
setting.theme.help: Takes effect immediately and repaints the current screen.
setting.title_color.help: Sets the color or gradient used for the unidl wordmark and service banners. Previews live as you browse options.
setting.title_delay.help: Optional batch-only delay before the next title starts. Use off, a fixed number of seconds, or MIN-MAX such as 20-40. It never delays tracks within one title or live recording segments.
setting.tmdb_api_key.help: Optional TMDB v3 API key or v4 token (stored privately and masked in logs).
setting.track_mode.help: Whether to show the track picker or select silently using these rules.
setting.upcoming_sources.help: Pick one or combine JustWatch, TVMaze, AniList, and TMDB for the Upcoming Radar.
setting.vault_read_targets.help: Choose vaults for automatic key lookup. Leave empty to use all enabled vaults; an empty selection disables lookup.
setting.vault_search_targets.help: Choose local and searchable remote vaults. Local keys appear immediately; remote vaults are only queried when you pick 'Search remote vault'.
setting.vault_write_targets.help: Choose writable vaults for saving licensed, rotated, and manually added keys. Leave empty to write to all writable vaults.
setting.verify_content_keys.help: Off by default. Verifies selected encrypted VOD tracks on a small sample before downloading. If a vault key fails, tries other vaults and then the CDM once. Skipped for live, export, and command-only runs.
setting.video_selection.help: Best one chooses the highest-quality video after filters. All keeps every video matching the selected constraints.
settings.group.download_help: These choices control what UniDL does after resolving a title, and native transfer options that are not covered by a service's Tracks and output settings. They do not change a service's manifest or track selection.
settings.group.interface_help: Theme, colors, language, experimental Home and diagnostics.
settings.invalid_speed: Use a positive rate such as 15M, 100K, or 2Mbps (or leave empty).
settings.modified_empty: All settings are at their defaults — press m to show all.
settings.no_cdm: {label} selected, but no matching CDM was found
settings.placeholder: type a value, then press Enter
settings.services.help: Manage licensing defaults, service registration, homepage visibility, chapters, attachments, actual video bitrate and export manifest type. New registrations require a UniDL restart.

storage.help.advanced: Read-only runtime paths. Click a row or press Enter to open the folder.
storage.help.naming: Customize filename and folder templates. The preview below shows a sample 1080p Dolby Vision episode and film.
storage.help.output: Edit output folders. Existing files are never moved; leave empty to use the configured default.
storage.notify.path_missing: Folder does not exist: {path}. Nothing was opened or created.
storage.placeholder.path: leave empty to use the configured default
storage.placeholder.template: type a template, then press Enter
storage.row.cache.help: Temporary service cache that can be safely cleared.
storage.row.cdm.help: Widevine, PlayReady and other DRM device files.
storage.row.commands.help: Generated UniDL commands, separated into one folder per service.
storage.row.download_dir.help: No YAML editing is required. Leave empty to use paths.downloads if configured, otherwise the default output folder. Files are grouped by service.
storage.row.episode_folder_template.help: Empty keeps the flat layout. Examples: {series} or {series}/{season}. Fields: series, season, season_number, year, season_episode and service.
storage.row.exports.help: Resolved-title JSON exports containing manifests, tracks and keys.
storage.row.filename_style.help: Choose dots, spaces, or hyphens between filename sections. Templates below remain available for fine control.
storage.row.helpers.help: Machine-local helper modules, binaries and assets.
storage.row.home.help: Default root directory for runtime data when paths are not overridden.
storage.row.keys_db.help: The default local SQLite key vault.
storage.row.name_template_episode.help: Fields: title, year, season, episode, season_episode and episode_name.
storage.row.release_tag.help: Optional group tag written after the final dash.
storage.row.release_template.help: Fields: quality, platform, source, audio/audio_full, atmos, video, range and tag.
storage.row.services.help: The services directory loaded by this UniDL installation.
storage.row.subtitles.help: Sidecar subtitles fetched by a service before UniDL muxes them.
storage.row.temp.help: Temporary directory for segment downloads and resume caches.
storage.row.tokens.help: Tokens, device identities and login sessions.

targets.help_remote: Remote vaults use the network only when selected.
targets.platform_help: Choose one platform to send one request per KID, or search all {count} declared platforms.
targets.search_help: Press Enter to search this remote vault, or Esc to cancel.
